title: zed-sync change event v1
description: The wire envelope both transports (Supabase realtime + backend catch-up) decode to. `version` is a Hybrid Logical Clock and is the ONLY reconciliation key; `sync_sequence` is the catch-up cursor and never feeds reconciliation.

row.description: Row payload for upserts; null for deletes.

at_ms.description: Server commit wall-clock (epoch ms); shown in UIs, never used for ordering.

write_key.description: Echo of a client's durable per-write idempotency key.

sync_sequence.description: Plane-wide commit-ordered catch-up cursor; never used for row reconciliation.

Hlc.description: Hybrid Logical Clock stamp. Total order: wall_ms, then counter, then actor.
